reviews.title: Very good and useful app.
reviews.text:
To all the people getting mad about the paywall, of course there’s a paywall! I understand his main audience is teens, who will have trouble paying for this, but this dude as far as I know makes the whole app by himself and it’s probably one of his main income sources bc youtube probably doesn’t pay really well even if u get a ton of views like he does. This is basically a personal trainer that you can talk to at all times, and $40 bucks a year is a steal. A human trainer could cost as much as $40 a week!

P.S. to anyone wondering, you can’t unlock apps in focus mode in silent mode because you cant receive the notification (myb u can go to notification center but i havent tried yet)
